title: Oil Change Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Engine Oil-Change Service: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Oil Change Estimate Worksheet covers vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval. The maintenance service advisor records Engine Oil-Change Service observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Oil Change Estimate Worksheet keeps Engine Oil-Change Service exceptions visible until the maintenance service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Oil Change Estimate Worksheet at service lane, lift bay, engine compartment, and customer handoff. Document vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval identity before Engine Oil-Change Service begins. Compare vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval findings with stated Engine Oil-Change Service criteria; route unresolved Engine Oil-Change Service issues to qualified automotive maintenance reviewer. For Oil Change Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Engine Oil-Change Service. Ask qualified automotive maintenance reviewer to review Engine Oil-Change Service conditions beyond the maintenance service advisor's role.

sections.title: Pricing evidence and service location
sections.guidance: For Engine Oil-Change Service, identify responsible parties, service lane, lift bay, engine compartment, and customer handoff, and the linked vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval source.

sections.guidance: Capture Engine Oil-Change Service facts for vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Engine Oil-Change Service estimate checks
items: Pre-service oil level and visible leak condition
Drain plug, pan, filter housing, and sealing surface

sections.title: Estimate assumptions and customer decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Engine Oil-Change Service conditions; have maintenance service advisor assign the next Engine Oil-Change Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Final level or leak check cannot be verified
Drain, filter, quantity, and final-level record
Post-service leak check and interval notice
blocks.guidance: Pause Engine Oil-Change Service when oil specification, sealing integrity, active leak, final level, or operating verification remains unresolved. Retain the available Engine Oil-Change Service proof and route unresolved vehicle, engine, oil specification, filter, drain and fill points, fluid level, and service interval scope to maintenance service advisor.
